specialist_investment_managers.name: Benefit Street Partners
specialist_investment_managers.description: Benefit Street Partners focuses on both liquid and illiquid credit strategies, bringing global expertise in areas such as senior secured loans, structured credit and special situations across public and private markets.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Brandywine Global
specialist_investment_managers.description: Brandywine Global is a specialist manager that seeks to identify value by targeting undervalued securities across a broad global spectrum of countries, currencies and quality ratings.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Clarion Partners
specialist_investment_managers.description: Clarion Partners is a real estate investment manager that offers a broad range of strategies across the risk-return spectrum, helping investors gain exposure to diverse property markets worldwide.

specialist_investment_managers.name: ClearBridge Investments
specialist_investment_managers.description: ClearBridge Investments is an active equity manager providing a wide array of strategies across developed and emerging markets, local markets, real assets and income-oriented equities.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Franklin Equity
specialist_investment_managers.description: Franklin Equity is an active equity specialist known for focusing on innovation and transformational change, applying deep research to identify long-term equity opportunities.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Franklin Income Investors
specialist_investment_managers.description: Franklin Income Investors is dedicated to income-producing strategies that reach across the capital spectrum into multiple asset classes to help generate consistent income.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Franklin Templeton Digital Assets
specialist_investment_managers.description: Franklin Templeton Digital Assets provides specialist expertise and resources to help advance digital asset investment strategies or businesses within the evolving digital finance landscape.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Franklin Templeton Fixed Income
specialist_investment_managers.description: Franklin Templeton Fixed Income is a global fixed-income platform offering multisector, corporate credit, European credit and emerging markets debt capabilities.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Franklin Templeton Investment Solutions
specialist_investment_managers.description: Franklin Templeton Investment Solutions builds multi-asset models and strategies by combining insights and research from across Franklin Templeton’s global platform.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Franklin Venture Partners
specialist_investment_managers.description: Franklin Venture Partners invests in private companies, combining deep expertise with access to mid- and later-stage opportunities through industry, academic and venture capital networks.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Lexington Partners
specialist_investment_managers.description: Lexington Partners specialises in secondary private equity and co-investment funds, including buyouts, growth capital and venture capital investments.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Putnam Investments
specialist_investment_managers.description: Putnam Investments offers a range of stock-driven equity portfolios designed to deliver consistent long-term performance while managing downside risk.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Royce Investment Partners
specialist_investment_managers.description: Royce Investment Partners is a small-cap equity specialist, dedicating over 95 percent of its assets to investment in smaller companies believed to offer compelling growth and value opportunities.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Templeton Global Investments
specialist_investment_managers.description: Templeton Global Investments brings together extensive local presence and expertise with a flexible investment approach to give clients access to broad global growth opportunities.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Templeton Global Macro
specialist_investment_managers.description: Templeton Global Macro manages flexible, actively oriented fixed-income portfolios that seek long-term value across yield curves, currencies and credit spreads.

specialist_investment_managers.name: Western Asset
specialist_investment_managers.description: Western Asset is a global fixed-income-only manager widely recognised for its active bond and credit solutions across developed and emerging markets.
